title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Green Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Green Edition Pre Filled Pods bring a fresh, juicy blend to the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod features Apple Watermelon - crisp, light and subtly sweet. The second delivers the tropical combination of Kiwi Passionfruit Guava for a punchier, more exotic flavour. Both pods come equipped with 5ml refill chambers that work automatically with the Dual 10K self-feeding system. It a versatile flavour pairing that balances bright and mellow with tropical sharpness. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
